note: Monte Carlo simulation of the rest of the real regular season -- real conference win-loss projection and P(finish with 6+ real wins) = real bowl eligibility. NOT a playoff-seeding simulation: the real 12-team College Football Playoff is committee-selected, not a standings formula, so this project does not fabricate a substitute for that real human judgment. Does not propagate rating uncertainty between trials -- read as a rough directional guide, not a precise forecast. See simulate_team_sport_season.py's module docstring for the full, real list of simplifications.
